title: Canon launches Ultimion, Japan’s first domestically produced Photon-Counting CT
lineage: Manufacturer's launch notice, corroborated for launch month by the manufacturer's subsequent Japanese chronology.

passages.locator: Opening; Ultimion will help advance clinical capabilities; note below event dates
passages.note: Announces sales in Japan from 17 April, reports work with a cadmium zinc telluride detector and joint research in Chiba since March, and limits commercial scope to Japan.
